description: This file defines a rate limiting utility with custom exception handling, including a stateless rate limiter class that implements adaptive exponential backoff, circuit breaker pattern, and error detection for rate limit errors. It is used to manage API request rates and handle retries with backoff delays.

classes.name: RateLimitError
classes.description: Custom exception class for rate limit errors, optionally including a retry-after duration.

classes.name: StatelessRateLimiter
classes.description: A class implementing a stateless rate limiter with adaptive exponential backoff, circuit breaker, and error detection for rate limit errors.

methods.name: RateLimitError.__init__
methods.description: Initializes the RateLimitError with a message and optional retry-after duration.

methods.name: StatelessRateLimiter.__init__
methods.description: Constructor initializing rate limiter parameters and internal state.

methods.name: StatelessRateLimiter._get_container_seed
methods.description: Generates a container-specific seed for jitter to distribute load.

methods.name: StatelessRateLimiter._is_rate_limit_error
methods.description: Detects if an exception is a rate limit error based on class, response status, or message keywords.

methods.name: StatelessRateLimiter._extract_retry_after
methods.description: Extracts retry-after seconds from an error if available.

methods.name: StatelessRateLimiter._calculate_backoff_delay
methods.description: Calculates delay with exponential backoff and jitter based on attempt number and retry-after.

methods.name: StatelessRateLimiter._check_circuit_breaker
methods.description: Checks if the circuit breaker is open based on timeout.

methods.name: StatelessRateLimiter._update_circuit_breaker
methods.description: Updates circuit breaker state based on success or failure.

methods.name: StatelessRateLimiter.execute_with_retry
methods.description: Executes an async function with retry logic, handling rate limit errors and backoff delays.
